message.content: According to Merrick, if Jaime had stayed true to the lessons he learned from Brienne and embraced his new values, it could have led to a more fulfilling life. Specifically, Merrick suggests that Jaime could have used his skills and experience to help rebuild after the war, potentially teaming up with Brienne to lead by example. This collaborative approach would have shown his dedication to honor and duty, and also helped to honor his growth. Additionally, focusing on helping the common people could have further strengthened their partnership and reshaped their legacy. Through these actions, they could have inspired others and created a more united front for Westeros, leading to a renaissance of sorts.
